summary: Browser fill works again from installed Linux builds, the AppImage sets up browser fill, and the AppImage uses your system's GLib.
Sync is in the release and works through a server you run, and secrets stay in native code behind a master password check.
Stricter PIN and master password rules, a way to request a new recovery kit if you lost yours but know your master password, and a security checkup that finds breached passwords.
Safer vault file saving, locked key memory on Linux, and a clear message when a save would pass the vault size limit.
Fixed an update from 0.1.1 through 0.2.2 that failed with a receipt mismatch.
Restoring a backup from an older release upgrades it, and a restore keeps a safety copy of your current vault.
The release process now carries Linux builds from start to finish.
Showing a saved password asks for the master password in a proper dialog.
Sesame runs on Linux, and writing a copy of your vault asks for your master password again.
Sesame can check for and install its own updates on Windows.
The first early access build, for Windows.
